editorial:
Imagine being a guy who spends his days stuffing dead animals and his nights fighting epilepsy. That is the life of the main character here. He is a lonely taxidermist who thinks he is much smarter than everyone else. He spends all his time planning a big heist, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. The vibe is very tense and moody, making you feel like something is about to go wrong at any second. You will find yourself rooting for him even though he is kind of creepy, mostly because you want to see if his big plan actually works out.

What really makes this work is the acting. The lead actor does a great job showing how unstable the character is without saying much. The pacing is a bit slow, but that just makes the shocks hit harder. If you like stories where a regular person tries to pull off a crime, you will love this.
endingExplained: The plan falls apart when the main character has a seizure at the worst possible time. He tries to trick others and play a game of cat and mouse, but he is not as smart as he thought. In the end, he doesn't get the money and ends up losing everything. The big twist is that his own mind and health were the things stopping him all along, leaving him trapped and defeated.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime stories with a twist.
